export_evidence: ImportKey (slug variant 'unilab-chemicals-and-pharmaceuticals-private-limited') shows the company as exporter with dated customs records, e.g. exact line: "2025-09-29 | UNILAB CHEMICALS AND PHARMACEUTICALS PRIVATE LIMITED | TO THE ORDER OF CETRIMIDE BP (CAS NO. :- 8044-71-1) | BOMBAY AIR CARGO, India | PENANG, MALAYSIA | 29420090 | 0634574". Further rows seen: 2025-09-27 Potassium Iodide HS 28276010, Nhava Sheva Sea -> Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, B/L 4010572; 2025-09-25 Benzyl Benzoate BP HS 29163120, Bombay Air Cargo -> Athens, Greece, B/L 0902565; 2025-09-24 Chlorhexidine Gluconate Solution BP HS 29420090, Bombay Air Cargo -> Karachi, Pakistan, B/L 9046561; 2025-09-23 Cetrimide BP HS 29420090, Nhava Sheva Sea -> Surabaya, Indonesia, B/L 2379558. Source counter: page header states "Total Shipments 96 Records detected", "Trading Partners 4", "Ports 7", "Latest Cargo 2025-09-29"; rows actually visible on the free view = 5 export rows (plus a separate supplier/buyer aggregate block that is not shipment-level). So 5 of 96 claimed rows were verifiable.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report domestic split could be retrieved. Attempted sources blocked or paywalled: zaubacorp.com (HTTP 403), thecompanycheck.com (HTTP 403), tofler.in (HTTP 403), volza.com (HTTP 403), eximpedia.app (HTTP 403), trademo.com (HTTP 403), importgenius.com (JS challenge). The ImportKey page shows only cross-border customs rows, no domestic GST or tender data. Domestic supply therefore not confirmed and not disproven — null, not invented.
note: Export activity is factually confirmed, not merely declared: five dated 2025-09 customs records with destination, HS code and B/L number, all showing the company as Indian exporter (air and sea lanes from Bombay Air Cargo / Nhava Sheva to Malaysia, Tanzania, Greece, Pakistan, Indonesia). Declared HS set (293331;293339;293430;294200) is broadly consistent with observed codes 29420090 (Cetrimide, Chlorhexidine Gluconate) but the observed shipments also include 28276010 (potassium iodide) and 29163120 (benzyl benzoate), which fall outside the declared list — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the actual codes should be recorded as 29420090, 28276010, 29163120 and the declared set corrected. Role: the company both exports (as shipper) and appears as a buyer/importer in counterparty blocks (e.g. suppliers Jiangsu Pharma Bridge Chemicals, Yancheng Longshen Chemical, Hebei Chengxin; buyers Addis Pharmaceutical Factory, ATM Co, Netchem Inc), so it looks like a manufacturer_trader / chemical trader rather than a pure manufacturer — classification tentative, no registry check performed (out of scope). Revenue and export volume: null — ImportKey exposes only a shipment count (96) and no value or tonnage; no financials were publicly retrievable. Domestic supply: no traces found in accessible sources, but this is a source-access limitation, not a negative finding — stated as unknown rather than 'none_found'. No sanctions, litigation or ownership checks were performed (out of scope for this role).
